description:
Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LegoMachine" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LegoMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Roles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Builder" name="Builder">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Design</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveSets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Build_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PartsCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Build</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Reorder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Test</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Test</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Redesign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Assemble</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Children" name="Group of children">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SortParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Custom machine project started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Design" name="Develop basic design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DesignOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DesignOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderGive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveSets" name="Give Lego sets to children">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderGive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GiveSort</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GiveSort</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SortMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Build_Merge" name="Build or rebuild subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SortMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReorderMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RedesignMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsCheck" name="Parts available in container?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Build" name="Build subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PartsYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuildTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Reorder" name="Reorder individual parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PartsNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReorderMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuildTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestGw</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Test" name="Test successful?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestGw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestOk</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestFail</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Assemble" name="Assemble subcomponents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestOk</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssembleEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Redesign" name="Redesign and rebuild subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestFail</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RedesignMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="Custom machine built">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssembleEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_Design"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DesignOrder" sourceRef="Task_Design" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderGive" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_GiveSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiveSort" sourceRef="Task_GiveSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SortMerge" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="Gateway_Build_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderMerge" sourceRef="Task_Reorder" targetRef="Gateway_Build_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RedesignMerge" sourceRef="Task_Redesign" targetRef="Gateway_Build_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_Build_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_PartsCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsYes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsNo" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck" targetRef="Task_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildTest" sourceRef="Task_Build" targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestGw" sourceRef="Task_Test" targetRef="Gateway_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestOk" name="successful" sourceRef="Gateway_Test" targetRef="Task_Assemble"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestFail" name="not successful" sourceRef="Gateway_Test" targetRef="Task_Redesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssembleEnd" sourceRef="Task_Assemble" targetRef="EndEvent_1"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
